name: ARISEN - Chronicles of Var'Nagal
source: Dive into Var’Nagal, a world filled with mysteries. Your nomadic tribe has been defeated. Here you are, captive, in the ship of your enemies. The Maccialatt’s army doesn’t try to hide the truth: you are going to be sold as a slave. Despite the chains around your wrists, this story is yours. You are the decision-maker. Freedom reaches out to you: you shall rise.
translation: 踏入充滿謎團的瓦爾納加爾世界。你的遊牧部族戰敗了，如今你淪為俘虜，被關在敵人的船上。馬西亞拉特的軍隊毫不掩飾事實：你即將被賣為奴隸。儘管手腕上纏著鎖鏈，這個故事依然屬於你，選擇權仍在你的手中。自由正向你伸出手：你終將奮起。
